title: Word formation (CAE Part 3)
note: CAE Part 3 shape: rarer suffixes, shifted stems, assimilating negatives · root families drawn from Václav's Ready for C1 list, all sentences original · EN-only cues (James, 2026-08-18)

cards.title: Part 3 at CAE
cards.body: Same task as at FCE — a sentence, a gap, a root in capitals — but the endings are rarer and the stems shift more. The capital word never fits the gap unchanged.
points: Decide word class first, then positive or negative.
One letter matters at C1: occurrence has double r, denial loses the y.

cards.title: Noun endings beyond -tion
points: obey → obedience: sometimes the whole stem shifts.

cards.title: Shifted stems
points: The vowel often changes: deep → depth, long → length, wide → width.

cards.title: Negatives
points: The context, not the capital word, tells you the answer is negative.
in- assimilates: im- before p, ir- before r, il- before l.

items.en: The war caused a serious shortage of fuel across the region.
items.gap: The war caused a serious ____ of fuel across the region.
items.explanation: -age: a shortage = not enough of something; shortness is the quality of being short.

items.en: The trial received worldwide media coverage.
items.gap: The trial received worldwide media ____.
items.explanation: Verb → noun with -age: cover → coverage (reporting of an event).

items.en: The removal of the statue caused a heated public debate.
items.gap: The ____ of the statue caused a heated public debate.
items.explanation: Verb → noun with -al: remove → removal.

items.en: His flat denial of any involvement convinced nobody.
items.gap: His flat ____ of any involvement convinced nobody.
items.explanation: deny → denial: y → i, then -al.

items.en: The final rehearsal ran until well after midnight.
items.gap: The final ____ ran until well after midnight.
items.explanation: Verb → noun with -al: rehearse → rehearsal.

items.en: She signed the contract, but with obvious reluctance.
items.gap: She signed the contract, but with obvious ____.
items.explanation: Adjective → noun: -ant → -ance. After 'with obvious' you need a noun.

items.en: The trainer expects instant obedience from every dog in the class.
items.gap: The trainer expects instant ____ from every dog in the class.
items.explanation: The stem itself shifts: obey → obedience.

items.en: Power cuts were an everyday occurrence in the village.
items.gap: Power cuts were an everyday ____ in the village.
items.explanation: Double the r, then -ence: occur → occurrence.

items.en: The report was praised for the accuracy of its figures.
items.gap: The report was praised for the ____ of its figures.
items.explanation: Adjective → noun with -cy: accurate → accuracy.

items.en: At that time, genetic medicine was still in its infancy.
items.gap: At that time, genetic medicine was still in its ____.
items.explanation: 'In its infancy' = at a very early stage; -cy noun.

items.en: A quiet anxiety spread through the waiting room.
items.gap: A quiet ____ spread through the waiting room.
items.explanation: -ious → -iety: anxious → anxiety.

items.en: The market offers a wide variety of local cheeses.
items.gap: The market offers a wide ____ of local cheeses.
items.explanation: -ious → -iety: various → variety.

items.en: The crew measured the depth of the trench before diving.
items.gap: The crew measured the ____ of the trench before diving.
items.explanation: Vowel shift: deep → depth.

items.en: Months of training doubled the strength of his grip.
items.gap: Months of training doubled the ____ of his grip.
items.explanation: Vowel shift: strong → strength.

items.en: The sheer length of the film tested everyone's patience.
items.gap: The sheer ____ of the film tested everyone's patience.
items.explanation: Vowel shift: long → length.

items.en: Measure the width of the doorway before you order the sofa.
items.gap: Measure the ____ of the doorway before you order the sofa.
items.explanation: Vowel shift: wide → width.

items.en: The plane cruised at a height of ten kilometres.
items.gap: The plane cruised at a ____ of ten kilometres.
items.explanation: high → height — note the spelling: -eight.

items.en: She spoke of her daughter's results with quiet pride.
items.gap: She spoke of her daughter's results with quiet ____.
items.explanation: Vowel shift: proud → pride.

items.en: The crisis pushed millions of families into poverty.
items.gap: The crisis pushed millions of families into ____.
items.explanation: Full stem shift: poor → poverty.

items.en: Pure curiosity led him to open the unmarked door.
items.gap: Pure ____ led him to open the unmarked door.
items.explanation: -ous → -osity: curious → curiosity.

items.en: The shelter survives on the generosity of local donors.
items.gap: The shelter survives on the ____ of local donors.
items.explanation: -ous → -osity: generous → generosity.

items.en: The discovery of oil brought sudden prosperity to the town.
items.gap: The discovery of oil brought sudden ____ to the town.
items.explanation: prosperous → prosperity: -ous → -ity.

items.en: He has guarded his sobriety carefully for ten years now.
items.gap: He has guarded his ____ carefully for ten years now.
items.explanation: sober → sobriety: -iety with a stem shift.

items.en: The storm struck the coast with astonishing ferocity.
items.gap: The storm struck the coast with astonishing ____.
items.explanation: -ious → -ity: ferocious → ferocity.

items.en: The judge dismissed the question as irrelevant to the case.
items.gap: The judge dismissed the question as ____ to the case.
items.explanation: 'Dismissed' tells you the meaning is negative, and ir- before r.

items.en: Religious intolerance drove thousands of families into exile.
items.gap: Religious ____ drove thousands of families into exile.
items.explanation: Driving people into exile is the opposite of tolerating them: in- + -ance.

items.en: He shook his head in silent disapproval as the plan was read out.
items.gap: He shook his head in silent ____ as the plan was read out.
items.explanation: Shaking the head signals no: dis- + approval.

items.en: The inquiry blamed the accident on the inadequacy of the safety checks.
items.gap: The inquiry blamed the accident on the ____ of the safety checks.
items.explanation: You blame an accident on what was NOT good enough: in- + adequacy.

items.en: The campaign aims to end adult illiteracy within a decade.
items.gap: The campaign aims to end adult ____ within a decade.
items.explanation: You end the problem, not the skill — and il- before l.

items.en: We apologise for any inconvenience caused by the roadworks.
items.gap: We apologise for any ____ caused by the roadworks.
items.explanation: You apologise for the negative: in- + convenience.

items.en: Years of short-term contracts left him with a deep sense of insecurity.
items.gap: Years of short-term contracts left him with a deep sense of ____.
items.explanation: Short-term contracts produce the negative feeling: in- + security.

items.en: He drummed his fingers on the desk with growing impatience.
items.gap: He drummed his fingers on the desk with growing ____.
items.explanation: Drumming fingers = the negative state, and im- before p.

items.en: The scandal exposed the dishonesty at the heart of the ministry.
items.gap: The scandal exposed the ____ at the heart of the ministry.
items.explanation: A scandal exposes the negative: dis- + honesty.

items.en: Police are still investigating the disappearance of the two hikers.
items.gap: Police are still investigating the ____ of the two hikers.
items.explanation: Missing hikers → dis- + appearance.

items.en: A minor disagreement over money grew into a lifelong feud.
items.gap: A minor ____ over money grew into a lifelong feud.
items.explanation: Feuds grow from the negative: dis- + agreement.

items.en: His immaturity showed in the way he blamed everyone but himself.
items.gap: His ____ showed in the way he blamed everyone but himself.
items.explanation: Blaming everyone else is the negative trait, and in- becomes im- before m: immaturity.
